strings.aNo: I-magistrate (siphatsimandla senkantolo lesitsatsa tincumo) ngiyo letsatsa sincumo. Kusebentisa inFORMed akusho kutsi inkantolo itakunika i-oda, noma kutsi emaphoyisa atawucinisekisa kutsi iyalandzelwa.
strings.aS1: Yisa lifomu lakho ku-clerk (umsebenti wasenkantolo) kunoma nguyiphi i-Magistrates' Court, ngesikhatsi inkantolo ivuliwe (imvamisa nga 9am kuya ku 3:30pm ngetinsuku temsebenti). Nangabe usengotini, ungafaka nesicelo nangaphandle kwaleso sikhatsi. Kumahhala, futsi awumdzingi ummeli.
strings.aS2: I-clerk (umsebenti wasenkantolo) uyabuka lifomu kanye nawe. Ulisayina embikwa-commissioner of oaths (umuntfu lovunyelwe kufungisa bantfu).
strings.aS3: I-magistrate (siphatsimandla senkantolo lesitsatsa tincumo) iyalifundza, imvamisa ngalelolanga. Nangabe ibona kutsi udzinga kuvikelwa nyalo, ikunika i-interim protection order (i-oda yesikhashana yekukuvikela).
strings.aS4: I-interim order (i-oda yesikhashana yekukuvikela) uyinikwa ngu-sheriff noma ngemaphoyisa. Iyakuvikela kusukela ngesikhatsi ayitfolako.
strings.aS5: Unikwa i-return date (lusuku lokufanele ubuyele ngalo enkantolo). Ngalelolanga nobabili ningeta enkantolo, bese i-magistrate (siphatsimandla senkantolo lesitsatsa tincumo) itsatsa sincumo sekutsi iyakunika yini i-protection order (i-oda yekukuvikela) yekugcina. Ciniseka kutsi uya enkantolo ngalelolanga.
strings.aS6: Nangabe ephula i-oda, kubike esiteshini semaphoyisa losisho efomini lakho. Angaboshwa.
strings.aboutG1: GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech) yinhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika lesebentisa buchwepheshe futsi lemele emalungelo nebullingana bebesifazane. Isebentisa buchwepheshe kwesekela bantfu labasindzile eludlameni lolususelwa ebulilini nekusita bantfu batfole lwati, lusito netinsita letimayelana nemalungelo abo, imphilo yabo nenhlalakahle yabo.
strings.aboutI1: inFORMed lithulusi le-GRIT le-AI lelisita bantfu kutsi bati kutsi benzeni ngetemthetho. Likhuluma njengemuntfu wemphakatsi lonendzaba nawe, alikujahisi futsi alikwahluleli. Lisita bantfu lababhekene neludlame lwasekhaya kutsi babhale lokubehlele esicelweni inkantolo lengasisebentisa kutsatsa sinyatselo.
strings.aboutI2: Ticondziso talo tisekelwe efomini lesemtsetfweni lesicelweni se-protection order, longumyalelo wenkantolo wekuvikela; eticondzisweni temalungelo mayelana neludlame lwasekhaya nekubhala sicelo lesicinile; elucwaningweni lwe-MOSAIC mayelana naloko bomantji labakubukako; kanye naseticondzisweni te-GRIT te-protection order.
strings.askDesc: Condza ngema-protection order, imiyalo yenkantolo yekuvikela, indlela tintfo letenteka ngayo enkantolo nemagama emtsetfo.
strings.askOpening: Sawubona, ngingu-inFORMed. Ngiluhlelo lwe-AI lolukhuluma nawe, angisiye umuntfu. Angeke ngikunike seluleko setemtsetfo. Ngingakuchazela kutsi ema-protection order (imiyalo yenkantolo yekuvikela ekuhlukunyetweni) asebenta njani, kutsi emagama emtsetfo asho kutsini nekutsi yini longayilindzela enkantolo. Yini longatsandza kuyati?

Usengotini nyalo? Shayela 10111.
strings.fillStart:

Sibonelo: “Loyo lengangithandzana naye uchubeka angisabisa. Ngifuna ahlale khashane nami.”
strings.footNote: inFORMed ikusita ulungise sicelo sakho se-protection order (umyalo wenkantolo wekuvikela). Akusiyo seluleko setemtsetfo futsi ayitsatsi indzawo yamabhalane wenkantolo nobe yeloya.
strings.footPw: Yentiwe yaba khona ngu-GRIT · Gender Rights in Tech
strings.formEnglish: Lifomu ligcwaliswa ngesiNgisi, kuze lisetjentiswe enkantolo.
strings.g1: Kusebenta ngendlela lebeka labasindzile embili futsi lecondza buhlungu labadlule kubo, kubeka kuphepha netidzingo tabo embili ebuchwephesheni nasekuhleleni kwe-GRIT.
strings.g2: Kwakha kanye nemiphakatsi, lokufaka ekhatsi besifazane labasha, labasindzile nebantfu lokuhlangenwe nako ngibo kusita ekwakheni lamathulusi.
strings.g3: Lusito lwetebuchwepheshe lolufinyeleleka kalula, lokufaka ekhatsi Zuzi, lokuyindlela yekucoca lesebentisa i-AI ku-app ye-GRIT, kanye nelusito lwe-WhatsApp nalamanye emathulusi etebuchwepheshe.
strings.g4: Tindlela letisebentako tekutfola kuphepha nelusito, lokufaka ekhatsi tintfo letifana ne-Panic Button ne-Evidence Vault ku-app ye-GRIT.
strings.gen: Yenta sicelo se-protection order (umyalo wenkantolo wekuvikela ekuhlukunyetweni)
strings.generalInfo: Lolu lwati loluvamile, aluveli etiqondzisweni ta-GRIT. Sicela uhlole kumabhalane wenkantolo.
strings.guideAudio: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, levela ku-GRIT. Le webhusayithi ikusita ugcwalise lifomu lenkantolo le-protection order, lokungumyalo wenkantolo wekukuvikela. Kumahhala futsi kuyimfihlo. Kute ucale, chafata inkinobho lenkhulu lehlata sasibhakabhaka letsi: Cala lifomu lami. Bese usho indzaba yakho. Akudzingeki kutsi uthayiphe. Chafata umbhobho lohlata sasibhakabhaka ukhulume, bese uyawuchafata futsi nasewucedzile. Bese uchafata Kulalele kute ulalele loku lokucondziwe, bese uchafata Tfumela nangabe kulungile, noma uchafate Phindza ukusho. Nangabe uvula Fundza uphimisele, yonkhe imphendvulo itawufundzelwa wena. Nangabe usengotini nyalo, shayela emaphoyisa ku-1 0 1 1 1, noma uchafate inkinobho lebovu letsi Phuma ngekushesha lesetulu kute uphume kule sayithi ngekushesha.
strings.h1: Gcwalisa lifomu lakho le-protection order, umyalo wenkantolo wekuvikela, ngelusito.
strings.hSadag: SADAG lucingo lwekusita bantfu labafuna kutibulala, emahora langu-24
strings.hTg: Coca ne-inFORMed, bhala nobe utfumele umlayeto welivi
strings.hfIntro: Nasi sicelo sakho, sifundvwa ngelivi lelivakalako. Nguloku lotakufunga enkantolo kutsi kuliciniso. Ungacindzetela Misa noma ngasiphi sikhatsi. Nangabe kukhona lokungakalungi noma lokushiyekile, ngitjele engcocweni, noma ukushintje efomini.
strings.howSub: Bomantji badzinga imininingwane lecacile nalecondzile kuze bakhiphe i-protection order, umyalo wenkantolo wekuvikela. inFORMed ikusita kutsi uyinike, kodvwa incoco ayivakali shengatsi ugcwalisa lifomu.
strings.iP1: inFORMed luhlelo lwekucoca lwe-AI lolwentiwe yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Akusiyo intfu futsi akusilo ligqwetha, futsi ayiniki seluleko semtsetfo. Ikusita kutsi ulungise umbhalo wekucala welifomu lenkantolo. Clerk of the court, longumuntfu losebenta ehhovisi lenkantolo, ubuketa lifomu kanye nawe e-Magistrates' Court ngaphambi kwekutsi ulisayine.
strings.iP2: Kuze ikuphendvule, inFORMed itfumela imilayeto yakho ku-OpenAI, inkampani lene-AI leyisebentisako. GRIT ayiyiboni futsi ayiyigcini imilayeto yakho. OpenAI iyacelwa kutsi ingayigcini, futsi ayisetjentiswa kucecesha noma ngabe nguluphi luhlelo lwe-AI.
strings.iP3: Ingcoce ayigcinwa nakancane: iyanyamalala nawuyivala lelikhasi. Lifomu lakho ligcinwa kulolucingo kuphela, kulelikhasi lelivulekile, ngako alilahleki nawuvula lelikhasi kabusha. Nawukhetsa “Gcina kuze ucedze ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi”, liyakhiywa nge-PIN loyikhetsako futsi lihlala kulolucingo uze ulisuse. Kute longalivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, ngisho ne-GRIT. I-PIN lekhohliwe ayinakutfolwa kabusha.
strings.iP4: Cindzetela Cala phansi noma Phuma ngekushesha kuze usule lelikhasi. Kususa lifomu leligciniwe, cindzetela “Chubeka nesicelo lesigciniwe” ekhasini lekucala, faka i-PIN yakho bese ukhetsa “Lisuse”. Lifayela le-PDF noma le-Word lodawunilodile lihlala kumafayela lodawunilodile elucingweni lwakho uze ulisuse.
strings.iP5: Lomunye umuntfu losebentisa lolucingo angabona emlandvweni webrowser kutsi uvakashele inFORMed, noma atfole lifomu lodawunilodile. Nangabe loko kungakubeka engotini, sebentisa i-tab yangasese (incognito), susa lokudawunilodile ngemuva kwekukusebentisa, futsi usule umlandvo webrowser yakho. Lifomu leligcinwe nge-PIN lihlala likhiyiwe. Ku-tab yangasese, lifomu leligciniwe liyalahleka nawuyivala leyo tab.
strings.iP6: Shayela emaphoyisa ku-10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428. Kokubili kumahhala. Ungasebentisa ne-app ye-GRIT, lenenkinobho yekucela lusito ngekushesha lekuxhumanisa nelusito.
strings.k1: Ungasifaka sicelo se-protection order, longumyalelo wenkantolo wekuvikela, ngekwakho, mahhala, ngaphandle kwemeli futsi ngaphandle kwekucala uvule licala emaphoyiseni.
strings.k2: Usifaka e-Magistrates' Court lapho uhlala khona, usebenta khona noma ufundza khona, lapho lomunye umuntfu ahlala khona noma asebenta khona, noma lapho kwenteka khona kuhlukunyetwa.
strings.k2s: Inkantolo ivamise kuvulwa kusukela nga-9am kuya ku-3:30pm ngemalanga ekusebenta. Nangabe usengotini, ungasifaka sicelo ngemuva kwemahora ekusebenta.
strings.k3: Ludlame lwasekhaya alugcini nje ngekulimala emtimbeni. Lufaka ekhatsi kuhlukunyezwa ngemiva, ngetimali nangekwecansi, kuhlupha umuntfu, kumetfusa nekufuna kumlawula.
strings.k4: Titfombe, emaphepha abodokotela noma bofakazi bangasita, kodvwa usengasifaka sicelo ngaphandle kwabo. Nemntfwana wanoma nguyiphi iminyaka angasifaka sicelo.
strings.knowSub: Kusuka emitfonjeni yeticondziso inFORMed leyakhelwe kuyo.
strings.learnH: Uyafuna kwati lokwengetiwe ngaphambi kwekutsi ucale?
strings.learnP: Buta noma yini ngema-protection order, lokuyimiyalo yenkantolo yekukuvikela, ngenkantolo noma ngemagama emtsetfo. Thayipha noma ukhulume. Ungalalela yonkhe imphendvulo.

strings.rN3: Uma inkantolo ikunika interim protection order, lokuyi-oda yesikhashana yekukuvikela, ihanjiswa ku-respondent, lokungumuntfu lofake sicelo ngaye. Ube sewunikwa lusuku lwekubuyela enkantolo.
strings.restoredPin: Libuyiselwe. Kuze uchubeke ugcina tingucuko ekhophi yakho legcinwe nge-PIN, khetsa “Gcina ucedzele ngekuhamba kwesikhatsi” futsi.
strings.s1d: Sitjele lokwentekile ngemagama akho nangelulwimi lwakho. inFORMed ibuta umbuto munye ngemusa ngesikhatsi, futsi ungema noma nini nawufuna.
strings.s2d: Imininingwane ngayinye iya esigabeni lesifanele efomini yenkantolo. Ibhalwa ngendlela bomantji labadzinga kuyifundza ngayo: emalanga, tindzawo, lokwashiwo nekutsi tintfo tibé timbi kangakanani.
strings.s3d: Dawuniloda lokubhalile kube yi-document ye-PDF noma ye-Word bese ukuyisa ku-clerk wenkantolo, longumuntfu losita ngemafomu, e-Magistrates' Court. Ungahlola futsi ushintje noma yini kucala.
strings.sBody: Sicelo sakho sitokhiywa nge-PIN futsi sigcinwe kule divayisi kuphela. Kute longasivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, futsi i-PIN ayitfunyelwa ku-GRIT. Incociswano yona ayigcinwa.

strings.safety.death: Ngingu-chatbot, futsi loku kuzwakala ngatsi simo lesiphutfumako lesidzinga lusito lwemuntfu. Nangabe unesikhatsi sekuhlela kutsi ungaphuma njani engotini, ngibute ngeluhlelo lwekuphepha. Nangabe lesi kusimo lesiphutfumako futsi udzinga lusito nyalo, shayela i-ambulensi ku 10177 noma emaphoyisa ku 10111. Letinombolo timahhala, ngako awudzingi i-airtime. Ungaphindze ulande i-app ye GRIT letakuhlanganisa nelusito usebentisa lesi sixhumanisi: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele noma iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.fallback: Ngiyacolisa, ngibe nenkinga yekuphendvula nyalo nje. Nangabe usengotini, shayela emaphoyisa ku-10111, noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (kumahhala, emahora langu-24). Ngicela wetame kutfumela umlayeto wakho futsi.
strings.safety.goodbye: Nangabe unemibuto leminye, sicela ubuye utobuta. Ngilapha kutsi ngikusite noma nini nawudzinga lusito. Sala kahle nyalo!
strings.safety.harm_other: Kumele kutsi uva buhlungu kakhulu kutsi utive ngalendlela. Ngingu-chatbot, ngako angihlali ngikwati kucondza imiva yebantfu. Licembu le GRIT liyati kutsi lingasebenta njani nemiva lematima nalebuhlungu. Sicela ubatfumelele umlayeto ku WhatsApp ku 072 737 8819.
strings.safety.immediate_danger: Ngingu-chatbot, futsi loku kuvakala njengesimo lesiphutfumako lapho udzinga lusito lwemuntfu. Nangabe unesikhatsi sekuhlela kutsi uphuma njani engotini, ngibute ngeluhlelo lwekutivikela. Nangabe lesi kuyisimo lesiphutfumako futsi udzinga lusito nyalo, shayela i-ambulensi ku-10177 noma emaphoyisa ku-10111. Letinombolo timahhala, ngako awudzingi i-airtime. Ungaphindze ulande i-app ye-GRIT letakuchumanisa nelusito usebentisa lesi sixhumanisi: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele noma iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.injured_now: Ngingu-chatbot, futsi loku kuzwakala ngatsi simo lesiphutfumako lesidzinga lusito lwemuntfu. Nangabe unesikhatsi sekuhlela kutsi ungaphuma njani engotini, ngibute ngeluhlelo lwekuphepha. Nangabe lesi kusimo lesiphutfumako futsi udzinga lusito nyalo, shayela i-ambulensi ku 10177 noma emaphoyisa ku 10111. Letinombolo timahhala, ngako awudzingi i-airtime.
strings.safety.rape: Akekho lofanelwe kudlula kuloko lodlula kuko. Akusilo liphutsa lakho. Ngingakusita njani?
strings.safety.suicidal: Ngiyacolisa kakhulu kutsi utiva ufuna kutibulala, kodvwa ngijabule kakhulu kutsi utive ungakhuluma ngako. Angisiye umuntfu, ngako kungenteka ngingakhona kukwesekela ngendlela lekucondza kahle konkhe lobhekene nako. Nansi inombolo ye SADAG. Awudzingi i-airtime kutsi ushayele, futsi umuntfu angakwesekela 24/7. Inombolo yabo ngu 0800 567 567. Ungaphindze ubuke i-website yabo: https://www.sadag.org
strings.safety.support: Nangabe udzinga kukhuluma nemuntfu nyalo, i-GBV Command Centre imahhala futsi ivuliwe emahora langu-24: 0800 428 428. Ungaphindze utfumele umlayeto ku-GRIT nge-WhatsApp ku-072 737 8819. Singema kancane nobe ngusiphi sikhatsi nawudzinga.
strings.safety.tracking: Angimniki muntfu imininingwane yakho. Ingcoco yetfu ayigcinwa nawuyivala.
strings.saveDemo: Kugcina kuyasebenta engcocweni mbamba, hhayi kulena yekukhombisa.
strings.saveKept: Lifomu lakho ligcinwa noma lelikhasi livuleka kabusha.
strings.saveNA: Ngeke ukwati kugcina kulomshini wekubuka emakhasi e-inthanethi.
strings.savedPinGo: Ligcinwe kulomshini nge-PIN yakho. Tingucuko tiyagcinwa njengobe uchubeka.
strings.serverErr: Uxolo, angikakwati kufinyelela kuseva nyalo. Sicela uphindze utame. Nangabe usengotini, shayela 10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428.
strings.sug1: Yini i-protection order (umyalo wenkantolo wekuvikela ekuhlukunyetweni)?
strings.sug5: Yini i-interim protection order (umyalo wesikhashana wekuvikela)?
strings.toAsk: Ngibute noma yini mayelana nema-protection order (imiyalo yekukuvikela). Lifomu lakho ligciniwe, futsi ungabuyela kulo noma ngasiphi sikhatsi.
strings.toFill: Asichubeke nesicelo sakho. Lifomu lakho ligcinwe ngasesandleni sekudla.
strings.typesNone: Tinhlobo tekuhlukunyezwa titawubonakala lapha njengobe tivela.
strings.underDemo: Demo: umuntfu lowentiwe kanye nenkhulumo lelungiselelwe.
strings.underLive: Inkhulumo yenu iyimfihlo. Inkhulumo ayigcinwa, kodvwa lifomu lakho liyagcinwa nangabe likhasi liphindze lilayisha.
strings.vCheck: Buka loko lengikuvile bese ushintja lokufunako, bese ucindzetela kutsi utfumele.
strings.vFail: Uxolo, angikakuveteli kahle. Sicela uphindze utame, noma ubhale esikhundleni saloko.
strings.vNear: Ngisalalele… {t}. Sekucishe kube ngemaminithi langu-3: madvutane chafata umbhobho lobovu. Ungaphindza urekhode lokwengetiwe ngemuva kwaloko.
strings.vNoSupport: Uxolo, lesiphequluli asikwati kusebentisa livi. Sicela ubhale esikhundleni saloko.
strings.vPerm: Ngidzinga imvume yakho yekusebentisa imakhrofoni yakho. Ungangivumela esipheqululini sakho, noma ubhale esikhundleni saloko.
strings.vQ: Nguloku yini lokushito? Ungawashintja emagama noma uwalalele.
strings.wa.askMore: Ungabhala noma utfumele umlayeto welivi. Nawufuna lusito ngesicelo sakho, tfumela {fill}.
strings.wa.code: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, letsiwa kuwe yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Ngicela utfumele ikhodi yekungena lowayinikwa.
strings.wa.docFail: Ngiyacolisa, angikakoni kutfumela lidokhumenti nyalo nje. Ngicela wetame futsi.
strings.wa.general: — Lwati loluvamile, hhayi loluphuma emihlahlandleleni ye-GRIT. Ngicela uhlole nalomabhalane wenkantolo.
strings.wa.help:
Ungabhala noma utfumele umlayeto welivi nganoma ngusiphi sikhatsi. Ungaphindze utfumele:
{ask} {about}
{fill} kuze utfola lusito lwekugcwalisa sicelo sakho
{form} kuze ubone sicelo sakho kuze kube nyalo
{pdf} noma {word} kuze usitfole njengelidokhumenti
{language} kuze ushintje lulwimi
{delete} kuze usule lengcoco

Nangabe usengotini nyalo, shayela emaphoyisa ku-10111 noma i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (mahhala, ema-awa langu-24).
strings.wa.next:
Lokufanele ukwente lokulandzelako:
1. Tsatsa lelifomu uliyise ku-clerk welinkantolo, umuntfu losebenta ehhovisi lenkantolo, kunoma nguyiphi i-Magistrates' Court. Kufaka sicelo kumahhala, futsi awudzingi ligqwetha. Nangabe ungeke ukhone kuliphrinta, i-clerk ingakusita.
2. Phatsa mazisi wakho nanobe yini lesekela indzaba yakho, njengetitfombe, imilayeto noma emarekhodi ekwelashwa.{missing}{bring}

Lelidokhumenti seliku-WhatsApp yakho kulomakhalekhukhwini. Nangabe kunalomunye umuntfu losebentisa lomakhalekhukhwini, lisule kulengcoco nawusakutfola lokudzingako. Kuze usule lengcoco ku-inFORMed, tfumela {delete}.
strings.wa.nextMissing: 3. Lokusekute kulelifomu: {list}. Ungangitjela nyalo ngikufake, noma i-clerk ingakusita.
strings.wa.textOnly: Ngingafundza imilayeto lebhaliwe futsi ngilalele nemilayeto yelivi. Ngicela ubhale noma utfumele umlayeto welivi.
strings.wa.voiceFail: Ngiyacolisa, angikawuva kahle lomlayeto welivi. Ngicela wetame futsi, noma ubhale umlayeto wakho.
strings.welcomeBack: Siyakwamukela futsi. Sicelo sakho sisekhona njengobe usishiye sinjalo, futsi ungasibona ngasesandleni sekudla. Sichubeke yini? Ungangitjela noma yini longatsandza kuyengeta noma kuyishintja.
